title: Kite Base
description: Two edges folded to a diagonal. The start of the fish and the swan.

steps.title: Diagonal crease
tips: Align corners first, then press from the centre out.

steps.title: Bottom edge in
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom edge to the diagonal crease.
tips: Start at the sharp corner and keep the point crisp.

steps.title: Left edge in
steps.instruction: Fold the left edge to the diagonal crease.
tips: The two edges should just touch along the centre.
mistakes: Leaving a gap between the edges.

steps.title: Point down
steps.instruction: Rotate so the sharp point faces down.
tips: This is how most diagrams show the kite.
steps.check: A kite with the sharp point down.
